Inspected original cover, roadmap, atom, ion, Lewis, formula, amount, reaction, assessment and feedback captures. Repaired inherited styles that clipped tablet inputs and made atom symbols pale. Coefficients now update visible molecular groups. Molecular drawings and ionic formula units use distinct labels.

Atomic circles represent shell populations, not electron trajectories; Lewis layouts are schematic. Molar batch bars are not individual particles. Rounded atomic masses are explicitly supplied in problems. Reactions model ideal complete stoichiometry, not laboratory procedures.
